messages:
priya: quick check — noticed vendor quota change for us-east1 GPU pool, getting a bunch of 403s on dedicated-canary. Anyone else? :eyes:

alex_m: yup saw spike in 403s around 23:05 UTC. got an alert from ops-bot, looking at vendor portal now.

ops-bot: Quota change detected for project: redwood-prod — region: us-east1 — resource: nvidia-a100: count_before=40 count_after=0 time=2024-04-12T23:05:12Z

sam: copying logs — curl to our inference host returns 403 on /v1/generate. quick grep shows error: "quota_exceeded: partner_reserve_required". Sample:
```json
{"error":"quota_exceeded","reason":"partner_reserve_required"}
```

luis: partner_reserve_required = vendor moving some capacity to partner-reserve pool. We need vendor PO/mapping to keep our reserved slots. Who owns procurement for this pool?

priya: this was for Dedicated Demo pool (dedicated-us-east-demo). We had an open PO with vendor but last week finance paused renewal. @karen can you confirm PO status?

karen: finance paused auto-renew last Tue — vendor sent final notice yesterday. I can reopen but need a cost code. Priya, can you confirm how many slots we need to restore? Also I'll need vendor's new invoice/quote.

priya: need 12 A100 slots for demo+canaries. If we can't restore immediate, can we request fallback to preemptible pool for nightcap tests? @alex_m?

alex_m: fallback possible but routing change required. Quick fix: set routing policy to fallback-tier:preemptible for route /demo-canary for tonight. I'll open a PR to switch routing TTL to 5m.

sam: PR snippet I'll paste:
```yaml
# infra/services/routes.yaml
- name: demo-canary
  model: northstar-a100
  routing:
    primary: dedicated-us-east-demo
    fallback: preemptible-us-east1
    fallback_ttl: 300
```

alex_m: thanks. I'll push PR and tag @eng-oncall.

ops-bot: Deploy bot — PR #4523 built and merged by alex_m — canary rollout started.

karen: I'll re-initiate PO renewal with vendor now and cc finance@redwood.eta. Expected vendor turnaround 24–48h.

luis: For short term, Alex's routing change + Sam's fallback should keep CI green. Priya, can you update the runbook with vendor contact + PO ref?

priya: done — added vendor contact + PO ticket #FIN-789. I'll monitor tonight and post updates.
